solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The correctly spelt word is 'Accelerate'.**
 
• The word '**Accelerate**' is a **verb** which means 'to begin to move more quickly or to increase the rate of something'. **(तेज़ी लाना)**

**Correct Usage:** The car can accelerate from 0 to 100 km/h in just 10 seconds.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Common Misspellings:**
 
 
• **Accellerate:** Incorrect spelling due to the addition of an extra 'l'.
 
• **Accelarate:** Incorrect spelling due to the replacement of 'e' with 'a'.
 
• **Accellrate:** Incorrect spelling due to the addition of 'll' and omission of 'e'.
 
 
• **Tips to Remember:** The correct spelling is 'Accelerate', with a single 'l' and 'e' in the middle.
